messages.content: Find MeSH terms co-occurring with LINC00954.
Which genes co-occur with the MeSH term Delivery?
MATCH (l:Literature) WHERE toLower(l.Title) CONTAINS toLower('tumor') RETURN l.Title, l.Year
MATCH (g:Gene {symbol:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE l.Year > 2021 RETURN l.Title, l.Year
MATCH (g:Gene {symbol:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE l.Journal = 'BMJ' RETURN l.Title, l.Year
MATCH (g:Gene)-[:CO_OCCURS]->(m:MeSH) RETURN g.symbol, count(DISTINCT m) AS mesh_count ORDER BY mesh_count DESC
MATCH (m:MeSH)<-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene) RETURN m.term, count(DISTINCT g) AS gene_count ORDER BY gene_count DESC
Top 10 MeSH for LINC00954 by Strength.
MATCH (g:Gene {symbol:'LINC00954'})-[r:CO_OCCURS]->(m:MeSH) RETURN m.term, r.Strength ORDER BY r.Strength DESC LIMIT 10
MeSH linked to LINC00954 with Strength ≥ 0.89.
MATCH (g:Gene {symbol:'LINC00954'})-[r:CO_OCCURS]->(m:MeSH) WHERE r.Strength >= 0.89 RETURN m.term, r.Strength
MATCH (g:Gene {symbol:'LINC00954'})-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) RETURN count(DISTINCT l) AS paper_count
MATCH (m:MeSH {term:'Delivery'})<-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g:Gene)-[:HAS_SOURCE]->(l:Literature) WHERE l.Year > 2023 RETURN DISTINCT g.symbol
Genes that share at least one MeSH with LINC00954.
MATCH (g1:Gene {symbol:'LINC00954'})-[:CO_OCCURS]->(m:MeSH)<-[:CO_OCCURS]-(g2:Gene) WHERE g1 <> g2 RETURN DISTINCT g2.symbol
Common MeSH of LINC00954 and TP53.
Papers mentioning both LINC00954 and Delivery.
